instruction.text: Select the person who holds this opinion:
instruction.sound: Select the person who holds this opinion.

cards.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3_chirp'>Climate change can no longer be stopped. Our grandchildren will grow up in a completely different world. And their grandchildren ... well, let's hope the next generations will benefit from new technological developments.</voice>

<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2In_chirp'>Far too much oil and other fossil fuels are still being extracted. We will never achieve our climate goals this way. This is problematic because our actions will have far-reaching consequences.</voice>

<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m8Au_chirp'>There should be a lot more investment into green energy. Future generations will thank us for it! And we owe it to them, because they cannot participate in decision-making today.</voice>

<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f8Us_chirp'>It has long been known that greenhouse gases drive climate change. But the fossil fuel industry has suppressed this knowledge in order to continue making profits. And even today, there is still a lot of lobbying against climate protection. If we really want to achieve climate justice, we will have to fight hard for it.</voice>

instruction.text: Select the person who holds this opinion:
instruction.sound: Select the person who holds this opinion.

cards.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f6_chirp'>As a gynaecologist, I feel like many people misunderstand abortion. I understand personal unease with the topic, but abortions can be performed safely up until the second trimester, until about 23 weeks.</voice>

<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3Au_chirp'>I am really happy that abortion got decriminalised in Australia. Women should not be penalised for taking autonomy over their bodies! I am glad that women's lives get taken seriously by our state. Clinics even have safe zones, were no harassment or protest is allowed to take place.</voice>

<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f8Us_chirp'>Those who restrict abortion rights, claim to defend life. If they truly cared, they would fight for stronger support for parents and children, like kindergartens, school meals and financial support, instead of limiting women's bodily autonomy.</voice>

<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m6Us_chirp'>Abortion and women's health rights have been a contentious topic for a long time in the US. I trust doctor's consensus more than personal opinions. I think ideology shouldn't get in the way of other people's rights.</voice>

instruction.text: Select the person who holds this opinion:
instruction.sound: Select the person who holds this opinion.

cards.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m4_chirp'>I think the minimum wage should be increased because people working full-time deserve to afford basic living expenses. People shouldn’t be struggling to pay rent or buy groceries.</voice>

<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f9_chirp'>Raising the minimum wage is only one way to reduce income inequality. I believe it would help close the gap between low-income workers and higher earners.</voice>

<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m9Us_chirp'>I’m concerned that increasing the minimum wage too much could hurt small businesses. I think some small employers might have to raise prices, cut jobs, or reduce hours to make up for higher labour costs.</voice>

<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f7Us_chirp'>I believe a minimum wage is necessary because many low-wage workers do essential jobs that keep society running. People working in roles like food service, cleaning, retail, and caregiving contribute in important ways, and I think they deserve much better compensation!</voice>

atoms.a: “Essential workers deserve at least minimum wage.”
atoms.sound: Essential workers deserve at least minimum wage.
